facts.fact: Egypt's unified government services card system is being rolled out in phases, with phase one in Port Said, phase two in Ismailia and Luxor and phase three planned for the remaining governorates, as reported to the Prime Minister.

The unified card system serves health insurance, food subsidy, Takaful and Karama pension and subsidised fertilizer through one card, with 41,500 ration families in Port Said, per the Prime Minister's meeting.

systems.platform: card linked to Egypt Post accounts
